title: Amper 现在更名为 Kotlin Toolchain：迁移至 Kotlin Blog
author: Joffrey Bion
content:
Amper has evolved into the Kotlin Toolchain, and our blog is moving along with it.

This isn’t a goodbye – it’s a continuation

With the release of Kotlin Toolchain 0.11, Amper became the Kotlin Toolchain: a single, unified entry point into Kotlin, now in Alpha.

What’s changing

To keep Kotlin ecosystem news in one place, all future news and release announcements will be published on the Kotlin Blog.

What stays the same

This blog will stay online as an archive, so existing posts and links will keep working, but it won’t receive new posts.

How to keep following along

  • Subscribe to the topics you care about on the Kotlin Blog, so you won’t miss any Kotlin Toolchain updates.
  • Follow the project on GitHub for releases and changelogs.

The Kotlin Toolchain team
